items.description: Mahindra Pretoria North is the brand's authorised dealership serving the Pretoria North and Dorandia area, trading from Rachel de Beer Street. Its own website presents the current Mahindra range, including Bolero MaXX 1.7T and 1.5T models, together with single-cab and double-cab bakkie derivatives such as the S6 and S11, each listed with finance-from pricing. The dealership invites customers to browse current offers, enquire about specific vehicles, or book a service appointment online, positioning it as a direct point of contact for both new-vehicle sales and after-sales servicing of Mahindra models. Covering everything from compact SUVs to heavy-duty double-cab bakkies, the dealership caters to buyers wanting rugged, work-ready vehicles as well as everyday family transport. Its location on Rachel de Beer Street gives it convenient reach across Pretoria North and the wider Dorandia area for motorists seeking Mahindra sales support, parts and scheduled servicing close to home.

Maincon Maintenance & Construction is a Doornpoort-based construction, plumbing and general contracting business with more than 40 years of combined experience in the construction industry. According to the company's own Facebook page, it positions itself around delivering high-quality workmanship across its construction, maintenance, renovation and plumbing work. Operating as a contractor rather than a product retailer, the business takes on projects that call on established trade skills built up over four decades in the sector. Based in Doornpoort, Pretoria, Maincon Maintenance & Construction is positioned to serve clients across the northern parts of the city who need experienced hands for building maintenance, renovation work or new construction and plumbing jobs. Its long operating history in the trade suggests a business built on repeat work and word-of-mouth reputation within the local construction and property-maintenance community, rather than large-scale marketing, with its online presence centred on a business Facebook page rather than a dedicated company website.

Mayville Pets is a pet shop operating in the Mayville area of Pretoria, trading six days a week with extended hours on most weekdays and shorter hours on Wednesdays and Sundays. Customer reviews describe the shop as a long-standing neighbourhood pet store offering everyday pet supplies such as dog food alongside more specialised stock, with one reviewer recounting how staff helped source medication for a dog being treated for parvo and another describing buying a gecko and the accessories needed to care for it. Reviewers generally describe the store as welcoming and helpful, particularly when assisting with product selection and pricing for pet owners' day-to-day needs. As a dedicated pet store in the Mayville area, it serves as a local option for pet food, supplies and advice without requiring a trip to a larger chain pet retailer, and its reputation among reviewers points to a shop that has built a loyal customer base over a number of years of trading in the area.

Maze Digital Marketing Agency is a Doringkloof-based digital marketing agency operating from the Spaces co-working space at Byls Bridge Office Park. According to its own website, the agency's core services include search engine optimisation, built around keyword research, site structure and content aimed at improving search rankings while adapting to AI-driven search tools, as well as inbound marketing focused on building brand awareness and trust rather than relying purely on advertising budget. It also offers digital marketing strategy development tailored to individual client needs, pay-per-click advertising campaigns across Google and social media platforms designed to maximise budget and reach the right audience, and social media content strategy intended to build trust and engagement. Operating from a shared office environment in the Centurion area, the agency positions itself as a hands-on digital partner for businesses wanting to grow an online presence through a combination of search, paid advertising, content and social media work rather than a single isolated service.

items.description: MiBOT Support is an IT support and managed services provider operating from Kloofsig, Centurion, serving South African businesses since 1999. According to its own website, the company positions itself as a proactive, outsourced IT department that aims to resolve problems before clients notice them, backed by a service level agreement offering sub-one-hour response times on logged incidents. MiBOT describes itself as a Microsoft partner and states it holds ISO 27001:2022 certification, reflecting a focus on information security management alongside its day-to-day support work. Its service offering includes full management of clients' Microsoft 365 environments, covering tenant reviews, security hardening, licence optimisation and configuration of Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, as well as layered cyber security measures. The company also highlights predictable, flat per-user monthly pricing rather than unpredictable call-out billing, aiming to give business owners clarity over IT costs. With more than two decades in the sector, MiBOT presents itself as an established, security-focused IT partner for small and medium businesses around Centurion.

MidTeam Real Estate is a real estate agency established in 2004 and based in the heart of Midstream Estate, Centurion. According to its own website, the agency describes itself as one of the longstanding estate agencies operating within Midstream, having built extensive knowledge of the broader Midstream Estates property market over more than two decades of trading. It specialises in the sale of residential and development properties across the whole of Midstream Estate, handling listings ranging from townhouses and apartments to larger freestanding houses within the estate's various precincts, such as Retire at Midstream, Midstream Heights and Ascend to Midstream. The agency's marketing also covers property alerts and bond calculator tools for prospective buyers. Having operated continuously from within the estate since its founding, MidTeam Real Estate positions itself as a specialist agency with an established presence and long-term familiarity with the Midstream Estates community, rather than a general agency covering the wider Centurion area.

Midteam Real Estate - Square@Midstream is the Shop 23 branch of MidTeam Real Estate, a real estate agency established in 2004 that has operated from within Midstream Estate for more than two decades. According to the agency's own website, it has built up extensive knowledge of the broader Midstream Estates property market over this period and specialises specifically in the sale of residential and development properties throughout Midstream Estate, including precincts such as Retire at Midstream, Midstream Heights and Ascend to Midstream. Trading from the Square@Midstream retail centre on Ashford Street, the branch gives the agency a visible, walk-in presence within the estate itself rather than operating purely online or from an office elsewhere in Centurion. The agency's marketing also includes bond calculators and property alerts for prospective buyers. Its continuous presence inside Midstream Estate since 2004 supports its positioning as a specialist, estate-based agency with long-standing local market knowledge rather than a general residential agency serving the wider Centurion area.

Milagro CBD Oil is a South African-based supplier of CBD oil products, operating from Tagore Avenue in Claudius, Centurion. According to its nichemarket business listing, the company sources its hemp-derived oil from Spain, describing its core product as a full-spectrum, distilled CBD oil created from organically grown hemp and extracted using a cold-pressed method intended to maximise the potency of phytocannabinoids such as CBD and CBG. Alongside its CBD oil, the listing shows the business also deals in related wellness products, including essential oils, face oil, a CBD balm and essential oils marketed for hair growth. The listing indicates the business accepts both card and cash payment and offers a call-out service to customers, suggesting a degree of flexibility beyond a standard walk-in retail model. Based in Claudius, the business serves customers across the greater Centurion area looking for CBD-based wellness products sourced from an established European hemp-growing region rather than an unspecified supply chain.

Mind Matters is a specialist management consulting company operating from Highveld Office Park in Centurion. According to its own website, the firm works with teams to help them connect, collaborate and perform better, using practical tools grounded in psychology and neuroscience to change how people work together rather than relying solely on conventional management theory. Client testimonials featured on the site, drawn from roles such as engineering managers, business managers in emergency services, IT executive managers and HR specialists, describe Mind Matters' input ranging from leadership coaching and change-management guidance to stakeholder-relationship facilitation during negotiations involving unions. The consultancy frames its work around helping organisations identify and address the real, underlying challenges affecting performance rather than surface-level symptoms, supported by a team the company describes as highly qualified and experienced. Operating from Centurion, Mind Matters positions itself as a boutique consulting practice offering tailored, relationship-driven engagements rather than standardised, one-size-fits-all training programmes for client organisations.

MiWay Insurance Ltd operates an office in Kosmosdal, Centurion, within the Brooklands Lifestyle Estate area. According to MiWay's own website, the insurer offers direct, online short-term cover for cars, motorcycles, caravans, trailers and homes, as well as business insurance, allowing customers to get quotes and manage policies without going through a traditional broker. The company highlights round-the-clock roadside and home assistance for customers who break down or need help at home, alongside a claims process that can be managed through its app with ongoing progress tracking. MiWay also promotes savings for customers who bundle multiple types of cover together, cover that can be customised with extras such as scratch-and-dent or tyre-and-rim protection, and a cash-back bonus for policyholders who remain claim-free over a two-year period. Positioned as a direct insurer rather than a walk-in agency, this MiWay office in Centurion supports customers across the wider Pretoria area who manage their car, home and business insurance primarily online or via phone and app.

items.description: Motomark Service Centre is a car repair and maintenance workshop operating from the corner of Zakheni and Lussin Avenue in Montana Park, Pretoria, trading Monday to Friday from early morning to late afternoon. Customer reviews describe the workshop providing vehicle servicing with an emphasis on clear communication, with reviewers mentioning being kept informed throughout the repair or service process and receiving professional, reliable updates rather than being left waiting without explanation. Several reviewers describe repeat visits for servicing, citing consistently professional, friendly and accommodating treatment from the workshop's staff. While some feedback notes occasional concerns around pricing and the experience level of part-fitting staff, the overall pattern of reviews points to a workshop known locally for dependable service and good customer communication. Operating from a fixed address in Montana Park, Motomark Service Centre serves motorists across the northern suburbs of Pretoria who need routine servicing, maintenance or repair work carried out at an established, locally reviewed workshop rather than a dealership service department.

Mugg & Bean Midstream is a branch of the Mugg & Bean restaurant chain trading from Shop 3 and 4 at Square@Midstream on Ashford Street in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein. According to the restaurant's own location page, it serves freshly brewed coffee, bottomless drinks and generous portions of breakfast, brunch and lunch, along with muffins and cakes described as made from scratch, catering to dine-in, takeaway and online orders. The branch operates daily, opening early morning and closing in the late afternoon or evening depending on the day, giving it both weekday and weekend trading hours for breakfast and lunch service. Positioned within the Square@Midstream retail centre, the restaurant is set up to serve residents of Midstream Estate and the surrounding Olifantsfontein area looking for a casual sit-down breakfast or lunch venue close to home, consistent with the Mugg & Bean brand's broader focus on a welcoming, community-style dining experience built around coffee and freshly prepared food.

Mugg & Bean On The Move Waterkloofrand is a grab-and-go format branch of the Mugg & Bean chain, trading from Shop 11 at Waterkloof Rand Centre on Buffelsdrift Street in Erasmusrand, Pretoria. According to the brand's own location page, the On The Move format is built around quick-service coffee, breakfast and lunch rather than full sit-down dining, offering freshly brewed coffee, bottomless drinks and generous breakfast, brunch and lunch portions alongside muffins and cakes made from scratch, available for dine-in, takeaway or online ordering. The branch trades seven days a week, opening early in the morning and closing in the afternoon on Sundays and later into the evening on other days. Positioned within a neighbourhood retail centre rather than a larger shopping mall, this outlet is set up to serve nearby residents and passing motorists in the Erasmusrand and Waterkloof Rand area who want a faster, more convenient version of the standard Mugg & Bean cafe experience.

Murrayfield Tennis Club is a tennis club situated in the Murrayfield suburb of Pretoria, operating from Clyde Street. According to its own website, the club describes its environment as friendly, competitive and community-focused, aiming to welcome players of all skill levels in a relaxed and inclusive setting suited to both social and competitive tennis. It offers coaching programmes for juniors and adults, along with social tennis sessions and competitive leagues, giving members a choice between casual play and more structured, league-based competition. The club positions itself as a place for people new to the sport, players looking to sharpen existing skills, and those seeking an active way to connect with others through tennis, rather than purely as a facility for established competitive players. Operating a dedicated clubhouse and courts within Murrayfield, Murrayfield Tennis Club maintains an active social media presence to keep its playing community connected and informed of upcoming club activities and league fixtures.

NALA Pretoria Consulting Engineers Pty Ltd operates from Nieuw Muckleneuk, Pretoria, as part of the wider NALA Consulting Engineers group. According to the company's own website, NALA has provided electrical, electronic, mechanical and project management engineering services since 2000, with project experience extending across South Africa, the rest of Africa and the United Arab Emirates. The firm describes itself as one of the first genuinely Black-empowered consulting engineering firms, having been established in Johannesburg before expanding its operations, with its BBBEE policy and company profile forming part of its public positioning as a transformation-focused engineering practice. Its listed fields of expertise cover multidisciplinary engineering work rather than a single specialism, reflecting a practice built to support electrical, electronic and mechanical design across industrial, commercial and infrastructure projects. Operating from Brookfield Office Park in Nieuw Muckleneuk, this Pretoria office extends the group's reach into the capital, giving clients in and around Pretoria access to a multidisciplinary consulting engineering practice with more than two decades of project history.

items.description: National Brands Ltd operates a manufacturing facility on Pepler Street in the Rosslyn Improvement District, Pretoria, as listed in the local business chamber's directory. National Brands Ltd forms part of AVI Limited, a company listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and centred on the fast-moving consumer goods market, with an extensive brand portfolio spanning more than 50 brands across categories including hot beverages, sweet and savoury biscuits and snacks, frozen convenience foods, out-of-home food ranges, personal care products, cosmetics, footwear, accessories and fashion apparel. AVI reports a turnover of R13.85 billion in its most recent financial year, supported by shared services spanning international operations, IT, finance, logistics, marketing, procurement and field marketing that allow it to operate at scale across its various businesses. The Rosslyn facility forms part of this larger group's manufacturing footprint, with the Rosslyn Improvement District directory specifically grouping it among food and beverage, confectionery and snack manufacturing businesses operating in the area.

National Entertainment Hub, trading as NEH TV, is an entertainment company and television service provider based on Market Street in the Pretoria West area, which includes the Booysens locality. According to its own Facebook page, NEH TV positions itself as a television service provider offering entertainment content, with its page describing it simply as an entertainment company. The business maintains an active social media presence, posting content and engaging with a large following of tens of thousands of people, and has shared video content through platforms such as YouTube in addition to Facebook. Based in the Market Street area of Pretoria West, NEH TV serves as a local entertainment and streaming media outlet, sharing content aimed at a broad online audience rather than operating as a traditional broadcast television channel with a dedicated transmission licence.

Ndalamo Resources (Pty) Ltd is a mining company headquartered in the City of Tshwane, with an office on Impala Avenue in the Doringkloof area of Centurion. According to its LinkedIn company profile, Ndalamo Resources is a 100% Black-owned and managed mid-tier coal producer, formed in February 2013 through the amalgamation of mining, financial, sustainability and social-responsibility professionals and entrepreneurs focused on mining investment opportunities within the South African sector. The company holds majority direct interests in the New Clysdale Colliery, North Block Complex and Ubuntu Colliery coal assets, alongside an interest in Universal Coal, positioning it among the country's Black-owned coal mining groups. LinkedIn lists the company as privately held, with between 201 and 500 employees across its operations. Based in Centurion, the company's registered office serves as the administrative base for a mining business whose actual coal assets and operations are located at its various colliery sites elsewhere in South Africa, rather than at the Doringkloof address itself.

netCFO is an accounting and tax services firm operating from the Regus Boardwalk offices on Boardwalk Boulevard in Faerie Glen, Pretoria. According to its own website, the firm positions itself around helping business owners avoid the costs of late SARS submissions, incorrect accounting records and missed tax claims, offering to handle day-to-day accounting so that deadlines and compliance issues do not get missed. Its listed services include bookkeeping, VAT and tax submissions, payroll compliance, preparation of financial statements, income and provisional tax handling, direct SARS support, and CIPC and company registration and setup work. The firm frames its value proposition around giving clients accurate, up-to-date books, timely SARS submissions free of penalties, and ensuring clients do not overpay tax due to poor structuring or missed valid claims. By combining these services under one provider, netCFO positions itself as an outsourced finance function for small and medium business owners based in and around Pretoria who want their SARS-related obligations and day-to-day bookkeeping managed by a single accounting partner.

New Snack Industries Pty Ltd is a South African snack food manufacturing company based on Aluminium Road in Rosslyn, Pretoria. According to its own website, the company owns two snack brands of its own and also undertakes contract manufacturing for a number of other brands, positioning itself as a manufacturing partner for other companies as well as a producer under its own labels. The company describes maintaining a high standard of quality and perfection in its production process, reflecting a focus on consistent manufacturing standards across both its own-brand and contract-manufactured products. Operating from an industrial site in Rosslyn, an area with an established cluster of food and beverage manufacturers, New Snack Industries forms part of the local snack food manufacturing sector supplying products to the wider South African market. Its combination of own-brand production and third-party contract manufacturing allows the business to serve both direct retail demand for its own snack products and the production needs of other snack brands that do not operate their own factory.

Nexa Online is a marketing agency based in the Orchards area of Akasia, Pretoria North, specialising in done-for-you LinkedIn management for founders and business owners. According to its own website, the agency positions itself around solving a specific problem: that many credible business owners are highly regarded in person but largely invisible online because they lack the time to run their LinkedIn presence as a consistent system. Its service covers profile optimisation aimed at presenting a business asset rather than a plain resume, planned and scheduled monthly content, engagement guided by a defined playbook, and management of direct messages intended to convert warm conversations into qualified leads rather than letting them go cold. Nexa Online describes its offering as one integrated system rather than a set of separate services, with each part intended to feed into the next so that visibility turns into engagement, engagement turns into conversation, and conversation turns into clients, hires or business partnerships for the founders and business owners it works with.

NJ Mongalo Attorneys & Legal Costs Consultants is a law firm based on Soutpansberg Road in Riviera, Pretoria, offering legal services alongside specialised legal costs consulting. According to a local business directory listing for the firm, its services include contract review, dispute resolution, litigation support and cost estimates intended to help clients understand likely legal costs before committing to a course of action. The listing describes the firm as delivering clear, practical guidance in a formal, client-focused setting aimed at both individuals and businesses, and notes that it operates on weekdays, Monday through Friday. Its premises are listed as including a gender-neutral restroom and wheelchair-accessible parking, indicating attention to accessibility for visiting clients. Combining ordinary legal representation with the more specialised practice of legal costs consulting, the firm occupies a niche within the Riviera and broader Pretoria legal market for clients who need both substantive legal advice and separate guidance on the costs associated with litigation or dispute resolution processes.

NovaSolis is an energy assurance and renewable energy solutions provider operating from The Point Business Park in Samrand, Centurion, within the Brooklands Lifestyle Estate area. According to its own website, the company brings together a portfolio of renewable and traditional energy generation, storage and management solutions aimed at power security and business continuity, addressing the complexity that arises when businesses combine multiple power sources such as solar panels, generators and grid supply without a unified way to manage them. NovaSolis states that it is the only integrator in Africa of hybrid power generators combining vertical axis wind turbines with solar panels, describing these systems as a compact, cost-effective alternative to relying on fuel generators or solar panels alone. The company positions its technology as providing real-time insight into energy consumption patterns, helping businesses make informed decisions about energy procurement, resource allocation and overall efficiency. Based in Samrand, NovaSolis serves businesses across the Centurion area seeking integrated solutions to manage multiple power sources during load-shedding and broader energy security challenges.

NoWire Technologies (Pty) Ltd is a telecommunications company based on Petrus Street in Rietvalleirand, Pretoria. According to its LinkedIn company profile, NoWire provides, installs and supports equipment and solutions within the ICT market, offering a range of data and internet connectivity services including 3G, HSDPA, IBurst and MyWireless technologies designed to suit a variety of customer requirements. These core connectivity offerings are complemented by GPRS communications and bulk SMS services, extending the company's focus beyond pure internet connectivity into broader data and messaging solutions for business customers. LinkedIn lists the company as a small, privately held business with between two and ten employees, consistent with a specialist technical operation rather than a large telecommunications provider. Operating from Rietvalleirand, NoWire Technologies serves business customers across the Pretoria area who need wireless data and internet connectivity solutions installed and supported by a dedicated technical team, positioning the company as a focused ICT equipment and connectivity specialist rather than a general computer support provider.

O.Joubert Attorneys is a Pretoria law firm based in Riviera, with its own website identifying it specifically as a medical malpractice practice. items.description: OfficePlace is a commercial property brokerage operating from Highveld Techno Park in Centurion, within the Bronberrik area. According to its own website, the company specialises in commercial property across Johannesburg, Pretoria, Cape Town and Durban, helping businesses lease, buy and sell office, retail and industrial space. OfficePlace describes its brokers as specialists in the specific nodes they represent, built on deep, on-the-ground experience and a clear understanding of how each property node functions and where particular types of businesses tend to operate best. Its website lists a wide range of current listings across these cities, spanning office space to let and for sale, retail premises, showrooms and business centres, together with tools such as property email alerts for prospective tenants and buyers. By combining real market insight with what it describes as a practical, hands-on approach, OfficePlace positions itself as a guide for businesses navigating commercial property decisions rather than a simple listings portal, operating its Centurion base as part of a national commercial property brokerage network.

OKSA Chartered Accountants is an accounting firm based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, founded in 2021. According to its own website, the firm was established to provide exceptional technical and strategic professional services to individuals, entrepreneurs and corporate clients, drawing on more than 30 years of cumulative experience among its team gained across Big Four firms, corporate environments and family businesses. The firm explains that its name, OKSA, derives from Oikonomos, meaning a trusted steward of household or public finances, reflecting what it describes as a core value of trusted stewardship built on deep mutual trust between the firm and its clients. Its service offering spans accounting and payroll services, tax and secretarial compliance, taxation, business intelligence and the preparation of financial statements, alongside specific compliance tasks such as provisional and annual income tax return preparation, VAT registration, and company secretarial work including registration of new companies and maintenance of share registers. Based in Koedoespoort, OKSA positions itself as a long-term financial steward for its clients rather than a once-off compliance provider.

One Stop Animal Rescue is an animal rescue service based on 1st Avenue in Heatherdale, Pretoria, operating seven days a week with slightly shorter hours on Fridays. According to reviews on its business directory listing, the organisation rescues animals, provides care for them, and works to place them in permanent homes, with reviewers describing the rescue as one where adopting an animal feels like taking in a member of the family rather than a transactional pet purchase. Multiple reviewers describe having adopted more than one animal from the rescue over time and praise the standard of care the animals receive while waiting to be rehomed, with one reviewer specifically describing having adopted two dogs from the organisation and noting the animals were well cared for. The listing encourages visitors to support the rescue through food donations in addition to adoption enquiries. Operating from Heatherdale, One Stop Animal Rescue serves the greater Pretoria area as a rescue and rehoming service for animals in need of new homes.

According to its own website, the agency positions its core offering around website development and graphic design, supplemented by active social media campaigns and search engine optimisation management intended to help client brands expand their reach. Peri Peri Creative describes its approach as combining strategy, branding and online marketing within a single managed service, stating that it aims to deliver work clients are satisfied paying for because it directly supports their growth, market share and profitability rather than being a generic marketing retainer. Client feedback featured on its website includes a technology-sector client noting the agency's particular focus on social media marketing and digital advertising, describing its advice as knowledgeable and its team as committed and responsive to client needs. Operating from Rooihuiskraal North, Peri Peri Creative serves business clients across the Centurion area seeking a combined website, design and digital marketing partner rather than separate suppliers for each discipline.

Petroleumfix (Pty) Ltd is a petroleum products wholesaler and equipment supplier based in the Montana Park area near Kameeldrift, Pretoria. According to its own website, the company draws on more than 30 years of experience in the petroleum industry, positioning itself around understanding the practical challenges customers face when sourcing the right equipment to build or maintain a fuel site. Alongside supplying petroleum products, Petroleumfix operates an on-site laboratory used to test and grade petroleum products, which it states ensures that every batch of fuel it supplies meets required quality standards. Its hardware range includes bulk nozzles, mechanical flowmeters, aluminium flowmeters and transfer pumps, aimed at equipping and maintaining fuel storage and dispensing sites for its customers. By combining supply of petroleum equipment with its own laboratory-based quality testing, Petroleumfix positions itself as a provider that can support both the hardware and the quality-assurance side of operating a fuel site, serving commercial fuel site operators across the greater Pretoria region rather than only retail fuel customers.

Pexmart is a manufacturer and supplier of HDPE pipes and fittings based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, serving both South African and international markets. According to its own website, the company specialises in thermoplastic welding and the installation of a diversified range of plastic pipes and fittings, manufacturing products used across mining, agriculture, industrial, and building and civil construction applications. Pexmart states that its piping is manufactured to SABS ISO 4427 standards and specifications, and that its lined pipe systems are designed for corrosive and abrasive products such as acid water, crude oil, slurry, wet gas and effluent, using an HDPE liner to protect older or newer steel pipes from internal erosion and corrosion. The company also manufactures HDPE water tanks, which it states can last up to 50 years and can be produced in a range of sizes suitable for schools, municipalities, mines and hospitals as well as households. Operating from Rosslyn, Pexmart positions itself as a specialist manufacturer serving industries that depend on durable piping and water storage infrastructure rather than a general hardware retailer.

Pholo Human Capital is a training and development company based in Woodhill Golf Estate, Pretoria. According to its own website, the company is a Black women-owned and managed business established in 2006, and obtained full accreditation from the ETDP SETA in 2007, giving it formal standing to deliver accredited skills development and training programmes. While headquartered in Gauteng, Pholo Human Capital describes itself as able to operate nationally, maintaining satellite offices in at least five provinces to support delivery of its programmes beyond the Pretoria area. The company states that its work is built around true and sustainable empowerment of human capital, lifelong learning, recognition of performance, and outcome-driven learning and capacity building, positioning these principles as the foundation of its training philosophy rather than treating training as a once-off compliance exercise. Its listed focus areas include enterprise development, human resources development and life skills training, alongside broader education, training and development practice work. Operating from Woodhill Golf Estate, Pholo Human Capital presents itself as a transformation-focused skills development partner for organisations across South Africa.

Pick n Pay at Blu Valley Mall is a supermarket branch anchoring the mall in The Reeds, Centurion, combining a full grocery offering with an in-store bakery and liquor store. According to visitor reviews collected on a travel-planning site, the store is noted locally for its freshly made magwinya, alongside a simple chicken-and-chips meal that reviewers describe as good value for money. Reviewers also highlight consistently good quality fresh milk, yoghurt and eggs, and describe staff, including cashiers, as friendly, contributing to a generally positive shopping experience. Some reviews note more mixed experiences with specific perishable items such as croissants, suggesting quality can vary day to day as with any fresh in-store bakery operation. Functioning as both a destination grocery stop and a quick bite option for shoppers at Blu Valley Mall, this Pick n Pay serves residents of The Reeds and the surrounding Centurion area for everyday grocery needs as well as casual takeaway food, with its bakery in particular standing out as a point of local reputation among regular customers.

Planet Fitness Heuweloord is a gym operating within the Mall @ 55 development at the corner of the R55 and Marais Road in Centurion. According to its own website, the club offers memberships starting from R299 per month, giving access to a facility built around cardio and weights equipment alongside group exercise classes. Its listed amenities include a dedicated functional training area, an indoor cycling studio and a separate group exercise studio, along with a lunge track for members wanting space to move through dynamic exercises rather than working from a single station. The club also lists secure lockers, free parking and free Wi-Fi among its facilities, and notes that it maintains a generator on site, a relevant feature for South African gyms needing to keep equipment running during power outages. The gym forms part of the wider Planet Fitness chain's presence across Centurion, with the Heuweloord branch giving members in that part of the city access to standard Planet Fitness facilities and a published class schedule without needing to travel to one of the chain's other Centurion locations.
